title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.  

  

You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.  

  

This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.  

  

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high\-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.  

  

If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead architecture, design, and delivery of GL and close systems, making technical decisions that balance near\-term reliability with the long\-term target state
* Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for your team, working backwards from FGBS customer needs and the broader GL modernization program
* Guide your team through system and process transformation — sequencing migration, modernization, and automation work while protecting the integrity and timeliness of every close
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of automation\-first thinking and technical excellence
* Own operational metrics and system health for GL and close systems, establishing mechanisms to monitor progress and drive continuous improvement
* Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
* Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline

  

About the team  

We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month\-end close — one of the most complex and high\-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub\-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions — ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration — that keep Amazon's financial engine running.  

  

What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state — and this role helps lead the way there.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Sr. Incorta Developer
description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced Incorta Developer with 6–10 years of experience in enterprise reporting, analytics, and data modeling. The role will design scalable Incorta data models, develop complex dashboards and reports, integrate multiple source systems, and optimize analytical performance while partnering with business and data engineering teams.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incorta Development and Data Modeling**

* Design and maintain Incorta physical schemas, business schemas, joins, materialized views, formula columns, measures, dimensions, and derived attributes.
* Configure ingestion jobs, data sources, pipelines, load plans, incremental refreshes, and data validation controls.
* Develop reusable semantic and dimensional models that support governed self\-service analytics.
* Translate complex business and reporting requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

**Reporting, Analytics, and Performance**

* Build complex operational, management, and executive dashboards and reports across multiple subject areas.
* Implement calculations, aggregations, filters, drilldowns, KPIs, exception reporting, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot and optimize queries, joins, formulas, schemas, ingestion patterns, and dashboard performance.
* Reconcile report outputs to source systems and resolve data quality or reporting discrepancies.

**Integration and Delivery**

* Integrate Incorta with ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS, finance, HR, and other enterprise source systems using database, API, file, or cloud\-based patterns.
* Work with data engineers on source mappings, transformations, data quality, refresh schedules, and lineage.
* Support design reviews, testing, UAT, defect resolution, releases, production support, and technical documentation.
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior developers and report developers.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* 6–10 years in business intelligence, enterprise reporting, data analytics, or data warehousing, including substantial Incorta development experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Incorta schemas, ingestion, Analyzer, dashboards, security, materialized views, and performance tuning.
* Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, incremental loads, data profiling, and data governance.
* Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar databases; familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder\-management, and documentation skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Incorta certification or formal training; experience with Incorta Cloud.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cognos, or comparable BI tools.
* Experience delivering analytics for supply chain, finance, procurement, sales, operations, or HR.
* Experience with end\-to\-end reporting\-platform implementation, migration, or modernization.

**EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage. The successful candidate demonstrates ownership, attention to data accuracy, structured problem solving, collaboration, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Flight Software Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.


We areseeking a Flight Software Engineer to develop, troubleshoot and maintain our Flight Software. The candidate will be one of the engineers responsible for developing new Flight Software, as well as providing Flight Software support for the Assembly, Integration, Test, Launch and Commissioning of our satellites. This will require the candidate to have an in\-depth knowledge of not only the Flight Software, but also the system as a whole. The candidate will be an integral member of the Flight Software Team, responsible for developing and maintaining all Embedded Flight Software for AST. All Embedded Software development is done in C\+\+ and can also involve hardware interaction for debugging and board bring\-up activities.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Responsible for the design, development, and testing of new embedded software from initial concept to subsystem integration, through full system deployment.
* Incorporate mission\-specific microcontrollers into full systems capable of full spacecraft control.
* Participate in design, code reviews and testing with the team.
* Debug and troubleshoot embedded systems, including system bugs, hardware failures or combability issues.
* Develop and test application\-level software modules that utilize low\-level peripheral drivers when applicable.
* Document and communicate design decisions and progress.
* Collaborate with other sub\-system engineers to define and advance software specifications for development.


**Technical Requirements:**

* At least 5\-7 years of professional experience working with Embedded Programming
* + Ideally with experience in development and support
* Familiar working with a Real\-Time Operating System (RTOS)
* Proficient with C and C\+\+
	+ Comfortable with the C\+\+ 11 (and beyond) standard library
* Experience with multi\-threaded environments
	+ Consideration for concurrency and inter\-process communication
* Familiarity with various protocols such as:
	+ Serial communication protocols (RS\-232, RS\-485, CAN, SPI, etc)
	+ Debugging interfaces (SWD, JTAG)
* Comfortable with development tools/technologies such as:
	+ Oscilloscopes
	+ Logic analyzers
	+ Multimeters
* Familiar with reading and analyzing circuit diagrams and schematics
* Comfortable using version control software, preferably Git
* Familiarity with the command\-line and command\-line tools
* Experience developing software on a Windows PC


**Qualifications**


* Familiar working with ARM microcontrollers
* Familiar with FPGA programming
* Familiar maintaining a large and complex codebase
* Familiar with some scripting language or languages (Python, Ruby, Bash, etc)
* Background in the Aerospace Sector
* Familiar with Matlab/Simulink


**Education:**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering preferred.


**Experience:**


* A minimum of 3\-5 years of professional experience in Embedded Software development.


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with STM32 microcontrollers, including proficiency with IDEs; familiarity with 32\-bit ARM microcontrollers/SoCs; FPGA programming knowledge; experience maintaining a large and complex codebase; scripting language proficiency (Python, Ruby, Bash, etc.); background in the Aerospace Sector; familiarity with Matlab/Simulink.


**Soft Skills:**


* Strong collaboration and cross\-functional teamwork skills; excellent written and verbal communication for documenting design decisions and progress; meticulous attention to detail in software development and testing; ability to work effectively within a team on design and code reviews; proactive in sharing knowledge and coordinating with sub\-system engineers.


**Technology Stack:**


* C, C\+\+ (C\+\+14 and beyond standard library); Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS); STM32 microcontrollers and ARM\-based systems; serial communication protocols (RS\-232, RS\-485, CAN, SPI); debugging interfaces (SWD, JTAG); development tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters; Git version control; Windows development environment; FPGA programming tools; Python/Ruby/Bash scripting; Matlab/Simulink.


**Physical Requirements**


* Ability to work in a standard office and lab environment; use of a computer and standard hardware debugging tools for extended periods; occasional interaction with electronic hardware and test equipment.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------


Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation
**About the Role**


We are seeking a highly experienced and hands\-on **Principal Software Engineer** to help define and build the next generation of our enterprise **Observability and Operational Intelligence Platform**. This role combines deep full\-stack engineering expertise, platform architecture leadership, product strategy, and modern observability practices.


The ideal candidate will have experience owning product direction, platform architecture, and technology strategy for enterprise\-scale engineering solutions. Prior experience building observability, monitoring, operational intelligence, AIOps, or telemetry\-driven platforms is highly desirable.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own and drive the technical product vision, platform architecture, and technology strategy for a cloud\-native observability and intelligence platform.
* Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, resilient, and highly available enterprise solutions.
* Build modern user experiences using **React, TypeScript, and contemporary front\-end frameworks**.
* Design and develop backend services, APIs, microservices, telemetry pipelines, and intelligence services.
* Define platform standards, technology selections, and engineering best practices aligned with long\-term product strategy.
* Design and optimize large\-scale telemetry ingestion, aggregation, correlation, and analytics pipelines supporting real\-time operational intelligence.
* Drive innovation across **Monitoring, Observability, Event Correlation, AIOps, Operational Analytics, Predictive Intelligence, and Self\-Healing Automation**.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, market trends, and customer needs to continuously evolve product capabilities and roadmap direction.
* Partner with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise challenges into scalable platform solutions.
* Establish engineering excellence across reliability, performance, automation, security, scalability, and developer experience.
* Mentor engineers, influence technical direction across teams, and serve as a trusted architecture leader.

**Qualifications**


* **10\+ years** of software engineering experience with strong expertise in full\-stack product development.
* Proven experience owning and delivering technical product direction, platform architecture, and enterprise technology strategy.
* Expert\-level proficiency in **React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS**, and modern UI architectures.
* Strong backend engineering experience using **.NET, Java, Node.js, or Python**.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise\-scale architectures, distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Strong experience with **Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP**, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering practices.
* Experience designing and optimizing large\-scale telemetry ingestion, processing, event correlation, and analytics architectures supporting real\-time operational intelligence.
* Deep understanding of observability concepts including **Metrics, Logs, Traces, Dashboards, Alerting, SLO/SLI Management, Incident Management, Operational Analytics, and Platform Reliability Engineering**.
* Experience with leading observability platforms such as **Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, Splunk, New Relic, AppDynamics, Elastic, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies**.
* Experience designing **AI\-powered intelligence layers** leveraging:
* + Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics
	+ Agentic AI Workflows
	+ LLM\-based Operational Assistants
	+ Graph\-based Correlation and Dependency Mapping
	+ Automated Incident Detection and Triage
	+ Root Cause Analysis and Remediation Recommendations
* Experience translating customer feedback, operational insights, and industry trends into platform capabilities and product roadmap investments.
* Strong product mindset with a focus on customer value, business outcomes, innovation, and engineering excellence.

**Preferred Experience**


* Experience building enterprise **Observability, AIOps, Operational Intelligence, Reliability Engineering, IT Operations, Monitoring, or Platform Engineering products**.
* Experience designing systems that process and analyze high\-volume telemetry data at scale.
* Experience building intelligent platforms that combine telemetry, AI/ML, automation, and operational workflows.

Exposure to SRE practices, self\-healing automation, anomaly detection, capacity prediction, and operational decision intelligence.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**  

As part of this team, you will work on mission\-critical platform services that power GitHub's global developer ecosystem. The team owns and operates high\-scale distributed systems, including GitHub Packages, GitHub Pages, Email Services, and other foundational developer experience tools and platforms. These services support billions of requests, stringent reliability requirements, and developer workflows used worldwide.


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for some of GitHub's most challenging scale, reliability, and operational excellence initiatives. You will lead design and implementation, make sound architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and collaborate across GitHub and Microsoft to deliver durable platform capabilities.

 **Responsibilities*** Lead the design, development, and operation of highly available distributed systems that power critical GitHub platform services.
* Drive architecture and technical direction for scalable backend services and platform capabilities using modern engineering practices, automation, and observability.
* Define and deliver improvements to service reliability, performance, latency, capacity, security, and operational efficiency for mission\-critical workloads.
* Own complex features and services throughout their lifecycle, from requirements and design reviews through implementation, rollout, production support, and live\-site excellence.
* Build automation and reusable platform capabilities that reduce operational overhead and improve engineering productivity across teams.
* Lead investigations of complex production issues across distributed systems, storage, networking, and service infrastructure, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Partner with engineers and stakeholders across GitHub and Microsoft to align technical strategy and deliver large\-scale platform investments and modernization efforts.
* Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, and leverage AI\-assisted workflows to improve software delivery, testing, incident response, and operational excellence.
 **Qualifications**  

Required

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems.
* Expert coding skills in one or more programming languages such as C\#, Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, Ruby, or similar, with a track record of delivering maintainable production software.
* Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, API design, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Proven experience designing and operating large\-scale backend services, cloud systems, or platform infrastructure with high availability and reliability requirements.
* Strong experience with databases, caching systems, messaging technologies, service\-oriented architectures, and observability practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous technical projects, influence architecture across teams, mentor engineers, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

* Experience with public cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and containerized services in production.
* Experience architecting high\-throughput, highly available internet\-scale systems and planning for capacity, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Strong knowledge of observability, incident management, reliability engineering, security, and production operations.
* Experience with GitHub, CI/CD systems, developer platforms, package management ecosystems, or internal platform products.
* Familiarity with Go, Ruby, MySQL, Kubernetes, distributed storage, service infrastructure, and large\-scale system migrations.

What Makes This Role Exciting

* Lead work on services operating at hyperscale, with billions of requests and global developer impact.
* Own production systems where reliability, performance, security, and operational excellence directly affect millions of developers.
* Shape technical direction and drive end\-to\-end engineering outcomes across complex, multi\-team initiatives.
* Collaborate with and influence GitHub engineering teams worldwide while mentoring other engineers.
* Solve complex distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and reliability challenges every day.
